finalCrew.blurb: Privateer gunner with a short fuse.

finalCrew.name: Vex
finalCrew.quote: The note lands. Then the round.
finalCrew.history: Vex learned to shoot by matching crystal harmonics to muzzle rise. Crew find it eerie. Enemies find it brief.

finalCrew.name: Kal Vesper
finalCrew.quote: I used to stamp hulls. Now I outrun them.
finalCrew.history: Kal flew Veil Gate customs until a bribe chain reached her commander. She kept the flight hours and lost the uniform.

finalCrew.name: Wisp
finalCrew.quote: I was already in the room.
finalCrew.history: Wisp condenses enough to hold a rifle and a name. The rest of the time they are weather with opinions.
